title: SKE Crystal 2400 4in1 Green Edition Pre-Filled Vape Pods 20mg - 4 x Pods
description: Explore a world of refreshing flavours with the SKE Crystal 2400 4 in 1 Green Edition Multi-Flavour replacement pods, exclusively at Vapestore. This collection includes Lemon & Lime, Blue Razz Lemonade, Fruit Medley, and Lychee Ice, each pod offering a unique and vibrant vaping experience. These Nic-Salt infused pods provide an array of delightful tastes and efficient nicotine hits, perfect for MTL vaping. These pods are tailor-made for the SKE Crystal 4in1 Rechargeable Pod Kit and feature an intuitive rotating mechanism, making flavour selection both easy and enjoyable.
